name: Lubong Nangoloan Falls
description: A short scenic hike leads to a cool freshwater falls, great for a half-day side trip. Guide fee is P500. You can also visit it via DIY tour. Just use maps and you can easily reach the area.

name: Sunrise Ridge Viewpoint
description: Popular sunrise/sunset spot with panoramic views of the valley.

name: Local Public Market
description: Fresh produce, grilled street food, and local delicacies to bring home.

name: Farm-to-Table Eatery
description: Casual restaurant serving local dishes, good for a meal before or after your stay.
